other_risks: threats to international security and global balance of power

mentioned.quote: Cyber offense, including model capabilities that could enable or enhance attacks on computer systems, networks, or digital infrastructure

threshold.quote: providing clear measurable thresholds for decision-making around offensive cyber capabilities.
threshold.note: two cyber tiers p.6; 2.3 p.5-6: when a model reaches a tier, safeguards proportionate to the risk are implemented

response.quote: Provided the residual risk falls within acceptable levels, taking into account appropriate safety margins, the model is approved for continued development, internal use (where applicable), and launch (as the case may be).
response.note: acceptance gate (E3); tiers guide additional mitigations before release; named safeguards in 2.3/2.5 are only 'may include'/'may rely'

acc_decider.note: no named role or body decides threshold, response or proceeding: p.10 says the risk owner documents the justification, p.15 says the Ireland board oversees implementation, which is not a decision

acc_external.note: external input is hedged: p.14 'We may solicit input from external actors'; external red-teaming p.5 and independent review of security controls p.13 are described practice, not a commitment on this risk's safeguards

acc_unmet.quote: if we identify any instances of non-adherence or any measures that are required to be implemented to ensure continued adherence, we will draft and implement a remediation plan.
acc_unmet.note: 7.2, stated with respect to EU Code compliance; no other non-compliance procedure
